title: Worktree preview on your phone is ready to merge

owner_note.text: Once a task lands, its worktree now stays up until its branch merges (48 quiet hours is the backstop). If the task asked for a preview, its dev server also answers the home Wi-Fi, and the merge card gets a "Try it on your phone" link that is computed, never typed. It's reviewed (38 checks pass, merge gate ok) on worktree/worktree-preview, not merged; it goes live after the merge plus `node Servex/sustain.mjs --restart`, never during a voice call. One choice I made for you: only preview tasks go on the Wi-Fi and are kept running, while other unmerged worktrees are only kept and still sleep when idle.
